summary: The Do or Dye Act amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to ban specific artificial color additives (Citrus Red No. 2 and Orange B starting Dec. 31, 2025; Red No. 40, Yellow No. 5, Yellow No. 6, Green No. 3, Blue No. 1, and Blue No. 2 starting Dec. 31, 2026) by deeming any food containing them adulterated.
